question: Henry Lawrence is associated with the battle of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chinhat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Henry Lawrence** was a British colonial administrator and soldier who played a crucial role during the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
 
• He is most famously associated with the **Battle of Chinhat**, which took place on June 30, 1857.
 
• The battle was fought between the British forces led by Henry Lawrence and the rebels near the village of Chinhat, close to Lucknow.
 
• Despite a valiant effort, the British forces were defeated in this battle, leading to the Siege of Lucknow where Henry Lawrence was mortally wounded.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Battle of Plassey:**

 
 
• The Battle of Plassey was fought on June 23, 1757, between the British East India Company and the Nawab of Bengal, Siraj-ud-Daulah.
 
• This battle marked the beginning of British rule in India.
 
 
 
• **Battle of Haldighati:**
 
 
• The Battle of Haldighati was fought on June 18, 1576, between the forces of Maharana Pratap and the Mughal army led by Man Singh I of Amber.
 
• It is one of the most celebrated battles in Rajput history.
 
 
 
• **Battle of Chausa:**
 
 
• The Battle of Chausa was fought on June 26, 1539, between the Mughal Emperor Humayun and Sher Shah Suri.
 
• Humayun was defeated, and Sher Shah Suri established the Suri Empire.
